prompts.generic-synth: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the attached synth illustration for an embedded groovebox display. Preserve the original dark charcoal body, almost front-on slightly elevated perspective, crisp 3D product illustration, lighting, transparent background and wide low silhouette. Correct the entire keyboard to a physically real 25-key piano layout: exactly 15 white keys C D E F G A B C D E F G A B C, with exactly 10 black keys in groups TWO, THREE, TWO, THREE. The black keys occur ONLY between C-D, D-E, F-G, G-A, A-B in each octave. Leave the E-F and B-C boundaries without a black key, creating very obvious gaps after every 2- or 3-key black group. Never four consecutive black keys; no equally spaced continuous black-key row. Keep key widths even and black keys raised and shorter. This precise correct two-and-three pattern is the most important requirement. Keep the full object visible, centered, no clipping. Output a single transparent PNG, no scene, no background, no checkerboard. It will be scaled to a 448 by 120 pixel transparent display asset, so use clear, uncluttered shapes. Keep the cyan-blue illumination, two oscillator panels and original controls. No text, letters, numbers or logos.
